Install adapters in private versioned directories and launch package bin scripts with the absolute Node.js path
Preserve upstream bounded npm version specs and package executable selection
Report executable and working directory on spawn failures

local_fixes.reason: Registry npm installation appeared stuck while npm retried network timeouts; LaunchDaemon rejected service-level proxy variables

Allow standard upper- and lowercase proxy variables in LaunchDaemon generation and registration
Keep proxy configuration in Environment server.env and document platform-specific activation steps

local_fixes.reason: Putting proxy variables into the root-owned LaunchDaemon plist made ordinary service-account updates require administrator registration
changes: Load only standard proxy variables as literal data in the installed server launcher on every start
Keep proxy settings out of generated system plists; preserve administrator registration for actual service configuration changes
Verify pending requests from the previous proxy implementation clear after successful ordinary activation
Update Environment guidance and packaging instructions
